name: Grime-Encrusted Ring
summary: In Gnomeregan, a Dark Iron dwarf carries a ring caked in toxic filth and hardened muck. The Sparklematic 5200 in the Clean Zone dormitory can strip away the grime and reveal its markings.

sections.title: A Relic Beneath the Muck
sections.body: Fighting leaves Gnomeregan's corridors coated in toxic sludge, oil, and radioactive fallout. Dark Iron dwarves infiltrating the city carry trinkets fouled by the filth, including a ring whose crust defeats ordinary hand-washing. Beneath it, the metal could be copper, gold, or junk.

sections.title: The Sparklematic 5200
sections.body: The Sparklematic 5200 in the Clean Zone dormitory accepts coins, scours fouled items, and returns them polished and wrapped with a bow. Cleaning the ring reveals a city's seal and engraved initials inside the band. The markings begin Return of the Ring, a journey to make restitution.

faq.q: Where do you find the Grime-Encrusted Ring?
faq.answer: Dark Iron dwarves inside Gnomeregan carry the ring.

faq.q: How do you clean the ring?
aliases: how to clean grime encrusted ring
faq.answer: Use the Sparklematic 5200 in Gnomeregan's Clean Zone dormitory. Insert the ring and pay the required coin fee for the machine to scour away the hardened muck.

faq.q: What happens after the ring is cleaned?
aliases: what do i do with clean ring
faq.answer: The Sparklematic dispenses a neatly packaged box with the restored ring and its personal engravings. This begins Return of the Ring, which leads you to find the ring's original owner.

faq.q: Can Horde players complete this quest?
faq.answer: Yes. Horde adventurers can clean the ring with the Sparklematic 5200. Later steps lead Horde players to an engineer in Orgrimmar instead of sending the ring back to Ironforge.

faq.q: Why is the ring wrapped in a gift box after cleaning?
faq.answer: The Sparklematic 5200 scours away sludge and grime, then automatically packages processed items and ties on a decorative bow, all with gnomish whimsy.
Several Sparklematic units line the wall in the Clean Zone dormitory, but only the one on the left as you enter by the stairs, near the friendly gnomes, works for the ring.

angles.text: The Sparklematic 5200 shows gnomish engineering at work, joining industrial solvent-scrubbing with an automatic gift wrapper.
As a gnome, you know that even as your city fell, its inventors designed sanitation machines that finish dangerous wash cycles with a cheerful bell and a bow.
As a dwarf, you can see the ring on an infiltrating Dark Iron dwarf may have been scavenged from Ironforge or from gnomish victims during Gnomeregan's fall.
